What is the total expenses of all three persons on Food?

30
solution:
**Calculation:**

Expense of Person A on Food = Rs. 5000

Expense of Person B on Food = Rs. 4500

Expense of Person C on Food = Rs. 6000

Total expenses of all three persons on Food = 5000 + 4500 + 6000 = Rs. 15500

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
